This is the `swear01/hapi` maintained build based on official HAPI `v0.23.4`, plus upstream `main` through [`deb5d636`](https://github.com/tiann/hapi/commit/deb5d63695cd68a1c12b468d2f321f6445b1d819).

## Compared with the previous maintained release (`v0.23.4.4`)

- Preserve Codex catalog `defaultServiceTier` and show the effective Fast tier when the session has no explicit override ([#1179](https://github.com/tiann/hapi/pull/1179)). Canonical `priority` and legacy `fast` are both recognized, while explicit Standard remains authoritative.

## Upstream PR audit

All 63 open upstream PRs were rescanned. #1179 is the only newly suitable focused fix; its upstream tests pass and the maintained-fork integration is fully validated. Existing maintained patches, including #1177 and the full #958 fix collection, remain carried. Codex local-session import remains excluded.

## Compared with the official release (`tiann/hapi v0.23.4`)

This build retains the existing maintained patch set and adds PR #1179 on top of `v0.23.4.4`.

## Maintained-fork guarantees

- Release tags must point to commits contained in `main` and match the four-part CLI version.
- macOS binaries are signed with the stable `xyz.hapi.cli` identity.
- Fork builds do not publish over upstream GitHub Pages or update the upstream Homebrew formula.
- The app shell is served with no-store cache headers.
